text:
Priya M: Heads-up — launch social plan ready for review. Need final hero image + 30s clip, copy for X & LinkedIn threads, scheduling CSV, paid ad CTA variants, and influencer seed list. Target launch Wed 2026-06-02 10am PT.

Leo D: Can do scheduling. We'll aim for 10am PT main push, 1pm PT thread + evening reminder. Who owns the influencer list?

Carmen S: I have a starter list (5 dev influencers). Will DM details. Requesting approval on benchmark phrasing: "3x throughput, 40% lower per-token cost" — legal ok?

Nate P: Legal flagged "per-token" as too casual; suggest "inferencing cost per token" or "per-inference cost". Eng confirmed numbers with a small margin.

Priya M: Use "inferencing cost per token" then. UTM pattern: utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_june2. Paid will use utm_medium=paid and utm_campaign=launch_june2_paid. Keep utm_content for creative variant (heroA/clipB).

Leo D: Uploaded schedule CSV: https://drive.redwood.launch/schedules/launch_jun2.csv. Will set up two paid ad CTAs: "Save your seat" & "Register now" and map to A/B test.

SocialBot: Reminder: asset cutoff 2026-05-29T23:59:00Z per campaign workflow.

Carmen S: Creative specs: hero 1200x628 JPG, clip 30s H.264 MP4, 1:1 thumbnail. Need alt text + 2 headline variations. Also request new logo lockup on all assets.

Priya M: Also add a short influencer DM template and one-sheeter with benchmark highlights. Keep the DM < 280 chars.

Leo D: Draft X thread outline: ```1/ Launch day: scale inference w/o bill shock. 2/ See 3x throughput + lower inferencing cost per token. 3/ Short demo clip. 4/ Live demo + Q&A — register: {short.link} #RedwoodLaunch``` Will fill in final copy.

Carmen S: For LinkedIn post, expand to 2 paragraphs, call out speakers + link to registration. I'll draft copy tonight.

Nate P: CRM routing spec: webhook fields -> source=social, campaign=launch_june2, source_detail=organic_social or paid_social, lead_score=calc(time_on_page, form_completion). Hot leads (score >= 80) -> sdr-launch queue + Slack alert to #sales-inbound. If company_size > 500 escalate priority.

Priya M: Engagement plan: assign two teammates to live-reply for first 3 hours (AM + PM shifts). Carmen takes AM, Leo takes PM. Also capture top questions for FAQ doc and a pinned follow-up thread with recording.

Leo D: Will coordinate community volunteers and schedule a pinned follow-up at +6h with recording/FAQ. Also plan a LinkedIn-sponsored boost the next day targeted at product managers.

Carmen S: I'll seed influencer list with short DM: "Excited to share our launch — short demo + benchmarks. Can we send you a clip to share? Heres the registration: {short.link}" Will include embargo instructions.

Priya M: Final sign-off meeting Monday 9am PT. Please add any blockers in Notion: https://notion.so/redwood/launch-jun2-social. :rocket:
